crossRefs.note: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might…
They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with…
When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry…

translations.web: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.
translations.bsb: and if someone forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.
translations.kjv: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
translations.asv: And whosoever shall compel thee to go one mile, go with him two.
